notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Combines full port scan (-p-) with service version detection (-sV). After open ports are discovered, -sV probes each with protocol-specific payloads to fingerprint application name and version. Banner-based first, signature-matching fallback.

=== HOW -sV WORKS ===
1. Read service banner after connection. 2. If insufficient, send protocol probe strings. 3. Match response against service database. Banner reading is fast; signature matching is slow — explains why -sV on all ports takes much longer than plain -p-.

=== OUTPUT ===
Service name, version number, extra info (OS, CPE). Version string feeds directly into CVE lookup and exploitation planning.
